column3: File extensions that are allowed in private workspaces for the account. Format: '.ext1, .ext2'. Use '<NO_EXTENSION>' to allow files without extensions. If empty, all extensions are allowed
File extensions that are allowed in shared workspaces for the account. Format: '.ext1, .ext2'. Use '<NO_EXTENSION>' to allow files without extensions. If empty, all extensions are allowed
YAML configuration for AI settings. Supports guardrails with advanced_prompt_injection rules and pii_detection legs.

Comma-separated allowlist of notebook runtime container image refs an account admin permits notebooks to run on. Empty means no allowlist. Each entry must match an existing notebook runtime environment.
Comma separated list of allowed workload types on SPCS. Valid workload types are as follows: ALL, USER, NOTEBOOK, MODEL_SERVING, STREAMLIT, ML_JOB

Allow any form of bind value access to users. This parameter should be set to false at the ACCOUNT level for customers who want to disable bind value access altogether. Each access path (e.g., BIND_VALUE table function, QUERY_HISTORY, etc.) also has its own parameter guarding access (these parameters have 'and' semantics: both this parameter and the access-path specific parameter must be enabled in order for a user to get access).
Allows client to cache MFA Authentication
Allow remote build services to pull base images from Docker Hub. When true, egress to Docker Hub endpoints is automatically granted to REMOTE_BUILD jobs without requiring an explicit EAI.
Whether the account can have ID Tokens issued

Allow remote build services to download npm packages and frontend CDN assets (Google Fonts). When true, egress to registry.npmjs.org, fonts.googleapis.com, and fonts.gstatic.com is automatically granted to REMOTE_BUILD jobs without requiring an explicit EAI.

Support row timestamp on table. If set on schema level and higher, the callbacks below will not perform table specific validations and not affect existing tables.  New tables will be created with row timestamp enabled.

When true, allows non-constant expression default values on V3 Iceberg columns. Expression defaults are evaluated by Snowflake at write time only. External engines see no default and must supply values or get NULL.
List of IPs used by Appstream to access customer accounts.
The base location prefix for managed or converted Iceberg table data relative to the Iceberg tables' external volume active storage location
Configured value of the database to be used for all budgets purposes for an account.
Name of the catalog integration to use for iceberg tables
Name of the catalog integration to sync this table
When true, CREATE TABLE / CTAS that omit the CHANGE_TRACKING clause create the table with change tracking enabled. An explicit CHANGE_TRACKING clause in the DDL still wins.
Client-side encryption key size in bits. Either 128 or 256.

If true, disable non-Snowflake network egress from CoCo Cloud Agents for the entire account. Defaults to false (egress allowed). Account admins can set this to true to block non-Snowflake destinations from Cloud Agent tool executions.

If true, disable the allow-all behavior for permission options in CoCo Snowsight for the entire account. Defaults to false (allow-all enabled). Account admins can set this to true to require explicit permission checks for CoCo Snowsight tool executions.
Daily estimated credit limit per user for Cortex Code CLI usage. A value of -1 means no limit. A value of 0 disables access.
Daily estimated credit limit per user for Cortex Code Desktop usage. A value of -1 means no limit. A value of 0 disables access.
Daily estimated credit limit per user for Cortex Code Snowsight usage. A value of -1 means no limit. A value of 0 disables access.
Comma separated list of allowed cortex cross regions. Order does not matter.
When true, forces SQL execution tool to be read-only at the account level, overriding any per-tool config. This allows account admins to guarantee that MCP SQL execution cannot perform writes.

Default metadata write format for tables created in this database or schema. Valid values: SNOWFLAKE, ICEBERG. Note: catalog-linked databases (CLDs) always promote CREATE TABLE DDLs to Iceberg implicitly, regardless of this parameter's stored value. The parameter cannot be modified on a CLD.
The default CPU compute pool used to run Notebooks.
The default GPU compute pool used to run Notebooks.

Default compute pool for building Snowflake Apps Docker images.
Default external access integration for Snowflake Apps builds that require external network access. Empty string means build without external access.
Default database where Snowflake Apps are created. Empty string means the CLI uses the personal database (USER$<login_name>).
Default schema within the destination database for Snowflake Apps. Empty string means the CLI uses PUBLIC.
Default warehouse for Snowflake Apps SQL queries during deployment. Empty string means the CLI uses the current session warehouse.
Default compute pool for running deployed Snowflake Apps services.

Account-admin-configurable default idle-timeout (seconds) for Streamlit apps that have not set IDLE_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_TIME_SECONDS. 0 = system default. Valid non-zero range: 86400 (1 day) to 604800 (7 days). Requires ENABLE_STREAMLIT_LIFECYCLE_CONTROLS_FEATURE.
Specifies the default compute pool for Streamlit applications.
The warehouse to run streamlits/notebooks if the WAREHOUSE property is not explicitly specified on the streamlit/notebook objects
When true, users with a local password who are unenrolled with multifactor authentication (MFA) will not receive a dismissable prompt at login to enroll in MFA.

Disables the Classic UI download button

The user lineage version of the customer facing account parameter ENFORCE_NETWORK_RULES_FOR_INTERNAL_STAGES used by managed policy migration. Users with this parameter enabled will have managed policy enforced on internal stage. We will deprecate it manually after customer migration is finished.
Enable enforcement the SNOWFLAKE_MANAGED_STORAGE_VOLUME network rule mode for type AwsVpceId.

Name of an external volume that will be used for persisted Iceberg metadata and data files.

When ENABLED, column comments propagate automatically along column lineage. Account admins set DISABLED to turn the feature off for their account, which also turns off the producer-side emission and consumer-side handler gates for COLUMN_COMMENT_CHANGED and LINEAGE_NODE_CREATED.

Enable Cortex Code sandbox (microVM isolation for code execution). When ENABLED or ENABLED_PUBLIC_PREVIEW, the Cortex Code CLI auto-activates sandbox mode for the account without requiring the CORTEX_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES environment variable.

Enables the workspace access request system functions. Setting this to ENABLED also enables ENABLE_GRANT_APPROVAL, ENABLE_LINEAGE_AWARE_RECIPIENT_CASCADE, ENABLE_REQUEST_ACCESS_FOR_WORKSPACES, ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_HIERARCHICAL_APPROVER_ROUTING, ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_REVIEWER_NOMINATION, and UI_ENABLE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_REQUESTS. ENABLE_GRANT_APPROVAL_EXPIRY_CLEANER must be set separately at system level.
This is feature parameter for RBAC Inherited Grants
When enabled, all users in the account are automatically advanced to the final worksheet migration (skipping the manual 'Migrate to Workspaces' click) by the PEP background job.
Number of days after which a PENDING grant approval request automatically expires. Set to 0 to disable expiry. Maximum value is 30.
Collation that is used for all new columns created by DDL statements on Snowflake-managed Iceberg tables (if not specified).
Controls merge-on-read behavior on Iceberg tables. Valid values are auto, enabled, and disabled. For 'auto' setting, MoR is enabled by default EXCEPT for v2 managed tables.

Default Iceberg version for new managed Iceberg table creation. Overridden by table-level ICEBERG_VERSION property if specified. Note: the default value must be synced with the default value of ICEBERG_VERSION
When true, ALL_USER_DETAILS returns the display name, the first name, the last name and the email. When false it returns the user names only.
Soft limit for the size of initial replication operation in terabytes. If set to zero, replication operation is not blocked based on size.
Limit on the total size in terabytes allowed for an initial listing auto-fulfillment refresh. Setting this to 0 disables the limit.
Listing auto fulfillment replication refresh schedule for listings that do not have a defined refresh schedule

Mapping between interfaces and IdP to redirect to when authenticating into a specific Snowflake interface such as Streamlit or Snowflake Intelligence. The format is a JSON object where keys are interface names (e.g., 'SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE', 'STREAMLIT') and values are IdP names as defined in the SSO integration (e.g., 'Okta', 'AzureAD'). Example: '{"SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE": "Okta", "STREAMLIT": "AzureAD"}'. This is a parameter that will only be set when LOGIN_IDP_REDIRECT account property is set.

If true, user name needs to be specified as an enterprise attribute snowflakeUserName instead of reading the value from userName attribute. However, login_name of an user will be always mapped to userName attribute.
Maximum number of SQL statements a warehouse cluster can execute concurrently before queuing them. Small SQL statements count as a fraction of 1.
Maximum number of days to extend data retention beyond the retention period to prevent a stream becoming stale.
Minimum allowable data retention time for an account. The effective retention time for any entity in the account is the max of this value and the DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS value for that entity.

Minimum allowable STAGE_UNDROP_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS for an account. Effective named-stage undrop retention is max(this, STAGE_UNDROP_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS). Capped by MAX_DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS.
Network policy assigned for the given target.
Comma-separated list of idle timeout options in minutes for notebooks in workspaces. The first value is the default option pre-selected in the UI.

Name of the External OAuth security integration whose issuer authenticates bearer tokens for API resources in this scope. When unset, Snowflake OAuth is used.
Comma-separated list of OAuth scopes clients should request when authenticating to API resources in this scope. When unset, Snowflake OAuth defaults to session:role:all.

Language for Cortex-generated object descriptions in BCP-47 format (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'ja', 'zh-Hans'). Supported languages: en (English), es (Spanish), fr (French), de (German), it (Italian), pt (Portuguese), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), zh-Hans (Chinese), zh-Hant (Traditional Chinese), ru (Russian), ar (Arabic), hi (Hindi), nl (Dutch), pl (Polish), sv (Swedish), da (Danish), fi (Finnish), no (Norwegian), tr (Turkish), and their regional variants (e.g., en-US, es-MX, zh-CN).
Cortex LLM model used for generating object descriptions (e.g., 'llama3.1-8b', 'mistral-7b'). See https://docs.snowflake.com/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/llm-functions#complete for available models.

Maximum scale factor per statement for query acceleration. Limits how many QAS workers a single request can use, expressed as a multiple of warehouse size. Value of 0 means no per-statement limit (warehouse-level limit still applies).
If set to 'GLOBAL', guarantees that changes from different sessions are immediately visible. This option incurs a slight performance impact.

Account-admin-configurable maximum idle-timeout (seconds) for Streamlit apps. 0 = no additional cap (system max of 604800 s applies). Valid non-zero range: 86400 (1 day) to 604800 (7 days). Requires ENABLE_STREAMLIT_LIFECYCLE_CONTROLS_FEATURE.

YAML document configuring Streamlit embedding controls. Currently accepts an allowed_embedding_domains list; the YAML shape allows additional controls to be added without new parameters. Entries must be https origins, except loopback hosts (localhost, *.localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1), which may also use http (e.g. http://localhost:3000) for local testing. Gated by ENABLE_STREAMLIT_EMBEDDING_FEATURE.
Customer-configurable threshold for the number of consecutive failures before auto-suspending an alert. Can be set at ACCOUNT, DATABASE, or SCHEMA level.
